Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_count NUMBER:=0;
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 08/17/2011. SCR 18384
 -- time zone change --02/16/11--sandip -- Modify by ash 04-08-2011 --
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,v_local_time); 
 --:fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day := to_char(v_local_time,'hh24:mi'); 
 :fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day := ltrim(to_char(v_local_time,'HH24:MI'),'0');
 --to_char(v_local_time,'hh24:mi'); 
 else
 -- :fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day := to_char(sysdate,'hh24:mi'); 
 :fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day := ltrim(to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'HH:MI'),'0')||' '||
 to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'AM') ; 
 end if; 
 
 --:fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day := ltrim(to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'HH:MI'),'0')||' '||
 -- to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'AM') ; 
 --:fixed_site_slots.s_time_of_day := ltrim(to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'HH24:MI'),'0')||' '||
 -- to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'AM') ;
 --:fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots := nvl(:fixed_site_slots.booked_slots,0) ;
 -- End of commented section */

 BEGIN 
 
 SELECT count(sch_date) 
 INTO :fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots
 FROM donor_schedule 
 WHERE site_id = :donor_schedule.site_id 
 AND to_date(to_char(sch_from_time,'hh24:mi'),'hh24:mi') = to_date(to_char(:fixed_site_slots.time_of_day,'hh24:mi'),'HH24:MI')
 AND sch_date=:donor_schedule.sch_date
 AND donation_type = :donor_schedule.donation_type
 AND proc_code = :donor_schedule.proc_code
 AND status = 'CNFRM'
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; 
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 message(sqlerrm);pause;
 :fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots := 0;
END;

:fixed_site_slots.avl := :fixed_site_slots.max_slots - :fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots ;

if upper(:fixed_site_slots.program_id)='MANUAL' then
 :fixed_site_slots.source:='M';
elsif upper(:fixed_site_slots.program_id)='ADHOC' then
 :fixed_site_slots.source:='A';
end if;


 /*set visual attributes */

 if :fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots =0 then
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.max_slots','green_attr');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots','green_attr');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.avl','green_attr');

 elsif :fixed_site_slots.avl < 1 then
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.max_slots','red_attr');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots','red_attr');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.avl','red_attr');

 elsif :fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots between 1 and :fixed_site_slots.max_slots-1 then
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.max_slots','yellow_attr');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.s_booked_slots','yellow_attr');
 display_item('fixed_site_slots.avl','yellow_attr');
 end if;

 
END;

 check_package_failure ;

 This program unit populates the calendar. Explanation of inputs are :

 while counter <= 35

 end loop; 
 --init_properties(curblk) ;

 /* Get the first day of the month */

 /* Get total number of days in the month */

 elsif Day = 'WED' then FirstDay := 4 ;

 Counter := 1 ;

 while Counter <= TotDays loop

 NextItemName := curblk || '.' || NextItemName;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
*/

 if upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK1' then

 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');

 Elsif v_sch_from_time < v_min_sch_time or v_sch_from_time > v_max_sch_time then
 /*-- Time slot out of range --*/

 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 then

PROCEDURE update_slots (p_oper in varchar2, 
 p_start in date,
 p_end in date) IS
-- p_oper will have two values 'ADD' or 'SUBTRACT'
 cursor c1 is 
 select booked_slots from fixed_site_slots
 where site_id = :donor_schedule.site_id
 and donation_type_group = (select donation_type_group
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = :donor_schedule.donation_type)
 and proc_code = :donor_schedule.proc_code
 and time_of_day between p_start and p_end
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 order by time_of_day
 for update of booked_slots;
BEGIN
 for op_cur in C1
 loop
 IF p_oper = 'ADD' THEN
 update fixed_site_slots
 set booked_slots = nvl(booked_slots,0) + 1
 where current of c1;
 ELSE
 update fixed_site_slots
 set booked_slots = decode(nvl(booked_slots,0),0,0, booked_slots - 1)
 where current of c1;
 END IF;
 exit; 
 -- This is due to the fact that only 1 slot is updated - ALWAYS.
 END LOOP;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;
